issue_context.title: Remove unused USE_REFEMIT define in System.Private.DataContractSerialization
issue_context.body:
`#if USE_REFEMIT` is used in a quite a few source files in DataContractSerialization, but it is never defined in a .csproj.

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/20131 mentioned it should be removed as it is unused, but that issue was closed because the .NET Native piece of it was resolved, and this unused define was never removed.

We should remove it, so it doesn't continue cluttering up the code and causing confusion when changes need to be made in this area. (For example - https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/41476#discussion_r479255963).
comments: Can I try to fix this issue?
